% Decks with degenerate shapes and missing picture wrappers; tests/check_browsers.py must pass on the build.
\documentclass{beamer}
\usepackage{kinetic}
\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{Zero-height move and zero-length morph}
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \useasboundingbox (-1,-1) rectangle (8,3);
    \only<1>{\begin{scope}[move=line]\draw (0,0) -- (3,0);\end{scope}}
    \only<2>{\begin{scope}[move=line]\draw (0,1) -- (3,1);\end{scope}}
    \only<1>{\begin{scope}[morph=dot]\draw[line cap=round, line width=4pt] (5,0) -- (5,0);\end{scope}}
    \only<2>{\begin{scope}[morph=dot]\fill (5,0) -- (7,0) -- (6,2) -- cycle;\end{scope}}
  \end{tikzpicture}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Morph outside a kinetic picture}
  \tikzset{every picture/.style={}}
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \useasboundingbox (-1,-1) rectangle (8,3);
    \begin{scope}[morph=box]\fill[blue] (0,0) rectangle (1,1);\end{scope}
  \end{tikzpicture}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Morph outside a kinetic picture, target}
  \kntransition{zoom}
  \tikzset{every picture/.style={}}
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \useasboundingbox (-1,-1) rectangle (8,3);
    \begin{scope}[morph=box]\fill[red] (2,0) rectangle (6,2);\end{scope}
  \end{tikzpicture}
\end{frame}
